text_block_list.text:
Three years with Symboli Kris S came to an 
end, and a little bit of time passed—

—When I arrived at the track for training, 
Symboli Kris S, who had arrived earlier, 
was surrounded by several other Umamusume 
for some reason...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Kris S-senpai! The personal training 
routine you taught me the other day has 
been super helpful!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I used to feel insecure about how easily I 
got tired, but lately, I've been feeling 
much better...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
—Kris S-senpai. My selection race is 
coming up soon... Would you mind watching 
my run like you did before?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I don't mind. —Shall we try running 
alongside each other, then?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
What?! Are you sure I can have such a 
valuable opportunity?!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's not fair! Kris S-senpai, please 
do it for me too!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Mmhââ

Seeing the younger Umamusume gather around 
Symboli Kris S with respect is deeply 
moving... especially compared to back when 
she intimidated and frightened them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—I too find her recent behavior quite 
intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
While fulfilling her stern duty as an 
"ordeal," lately she seems to have been 
offering more of that earnest guidance of 
hers.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...She might actually have the makings of 
a leader."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And this, too— might just be your 
influence.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu— Two peas in a pod, as always, it 
seems.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Please continue to look after her, <username> 
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Sorry. I was consulting with my 
juniors... I didn't notice you sooner.
choice_data_list: No. I think that's a good thing.

text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S influencing the next 
generation through guidance, and not just 
her running, is something that will lead 
to a future "revolution."

As someone who carries that very same 
"mission," I find this truly delightful—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, among them... there are 
those—who harbor remarkable potential.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Something that will— bring a true 
'shock'... to the era—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I would be thrilled... if they run toward 
the future—as the ones who bring about a 
"revolution."
choice_data_list:
Then I'll have to stand firmly in your 
way!

way!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yeah. —As their "trial."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...To watch over their growth— and to find 
joy in it—is...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: So this is what it feels like—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Just a little... I feel like I 
understand... —how Trainer feels.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —It's the same.
